review_scope.primary_scope: Targeted rereading of the main mIGF article, historical insulin comparison, current cenegermin label, August2026 insulin sensory abstract, Spanish trial protocol and legacy official trial record.
review_scope.checks: Source-to-claim fidelity; species, compartment, concentration and endpoint distinctions; units and denominators; reported versus verified methods; actual access level; causal limits; useful practical regimen versus universal molar equivalence; trial plans versus results; conditional marginal-value scope; finite retrieval and restrictions.

checks.assessment: Main-text identity is kept separate from terminal chemistry, analytical supplement and a future batch. Figures and supplementary values are not represented as independently digitized or read. An access failure is not converted into proof of absent data.

Acute and dexamethasone-delayed rat settings remain distinct. Figure-level n, administration volume and frequency are reported only where recovered; the report does not relabel delayed injury as established chronic human disease or infer full eye/animal independence.

The recorded similar healing percentages do not become a formal noninferiority result, a dose-normalized efficacy comparison or demonstrated human convenience. Equal molarity between distinct products is not imposed as a universal commercial gate.

Nominal cell concentration, tracer retention, aqueous-humor PK, surface closure, architecture, nerve staining and sensation remain distinct measurements. The audit retains functional sensory evidence without promoting it to durable human nerve restoration or a therapeutic window.

Acute postoperative randomized trials are distinguished from refractory PED cohorts. Per-drop activity is not equated to IU/mL; products, vehicles and observation periods remain source specific. The 28-eye PED subset is not replaced by the heterogeneous 57-eye cohort denominator.

The insulin-versus-serum evidence is correctly identified as historical control. Closure times are conditional on healing, and unequal follow-up is retained as a barrier to interpreting crude recurrence as a causal durability advantage. Nonsignificant baseline tests do not establish exchangeability.

The newer insulin sensory abstract is acknowledged while its inaccessible effect magnitude, complete-case denominator and treatment-course details remain unresolved. Its uncontrolled signal is not translated into structural reinnervation or a definitive treatment effect.

Planned enrollment and a projected completion date are separated from observed completion/results. The legacy registry display is not represented as verified live accrual. Approved NK label endpoints and exclusions are preserved; the separate PCED study-start disclosure is not treated as efficacy.

Equivalent useful repair with a meaningful practical advantage remains a possible value proposition, not an observed advantage. Ingredient price is not delivered sterile-product cost. The illustrative original envelope is not a quote, and qualification-only work requires a new comparison of information yield even at unchanged price.

Both JSON files parse; evidence source_ids and claim support IDs resolve within their own source/evidence/local-input namespace. Their candidate, base commit, base tree and six false activity flags agree. No reviewed file was edited by this reviewer.

targeted_primary_spot_checks.verified: Animal-model distinctions, reported frequency comparison, figure sample labels, tracer retention, aqueous-humor HPLC in rabbits and the separation of these from epithelial target exposure.
Historical periods and exclusion rules, shared background care, closure counts, healer-only time summaries and unequal follow-up are faithfully qualified.
Exact NK product regimen, strict week-eight healing denominators and no-postbaseline exclusion, recurrence subset and limited sensitivity conclusion agree with the label.
The report preserves the sensory signal and the unresolved treatment-duration inconsistency without inferring a complete-closure denominator.
Enrollment and completion language are prospective protocol statements, not randomized outcome or observed recruitment completion.
Legacy display says Ongoing with an empty trial-results field. This does not verify current live recruitment or absence of results in every possible location.

Reviewer verified identity but did not independently re-audit the numerical abstract because targeted subsequent retrieval returned no substantive text. Per-drop versus concentration consistency was checked in the authored pair; author-reported primary abstract scope remains explicit.
